sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 15283 of 2023
Applicant :- Meera Srivastava
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Civil Secrt. Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Desh Mitra Anand
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Amrita Singh,Brijesh Singh Vishen
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.

1 .  A request for adjournment of the case has been made on behalf of Shri Brjiesh Singh Vishen,
learned counsel for the opposite party no.2.
2.
On 09.06.2025 also, when the case was listed, adjournment had been sought on behalf ofShri Brjiesh Singh Vishen on the ground of his illness.

While adjourning the case, this Court had specifically mentioned that in case the learned counsel for the complainant fails to assist the Court even on the next date, the matter shall be decided finally.

3. Accordingly, the Court proceeds to decide the bail application after hearing the submissions of theShri Desh Mitra Anand, learned counsel for the applicant, Shri Jayant Singh Tomar, learned A.G.A.-I for the State and perusing the records.

4.The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.161 Meera Srivastava vs State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Civil ... on 7 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/44531314/
1 of 2020, under Sections 409, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B, 506 I.P.C. registered at Police Station Gomti Nagar, District Lucknow.

entities.text: Case Crime No.161 Meera Srivastava vs State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Civil
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. alleging that the informant had made investments in Shine City Infra Project Ltd. but no benefit was given to him on the investments made in the aforesaid company.
6. In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, it has been stated that the applicant is a woman who is an innocent person and has been falsely implicated in the present case.

7. The applicant's involvement in 90 other criminal cases has been disclosed in para 28 of the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, all of which are similar in nature and the applicant has already been granted bail in 75 cases of similar nature.
8. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant is languishing in jail since 20.10.2021 and merely charges have been framed in about 10 cases in the last week.
Not a single prosecution witness has been examined and in numerous cases, even charges have not been framed till date.
9. Learned A.G.A.-I has vehemently opposed the bail application but could not dispute the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case.

10. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail in the aforesaid crime.
11. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
